title: v0.7.1 gap closure: AUDIT-05, OP-04, USB-06
description:
Close three gaps found in milestone audit:

1. AUDIT-05: Wire agent_unknown_app() sentinel into audit_emitter.rs::emit_audit() so null app identity fields are replaced with AGENT-UNKNOWN before emission.

2. OP-04: Add shutdown signal (watch::Receiver<bool>) to spawn_encryption_check_task so the encryption interval loop participates in graceful shutdown instead of being force-dropped by runtime timeout.

3. USB-06: Pass current process SID into UsbEnforcer::check, add owner_sid/owner_user to UsbBlockResult, and propagate to audit event in interception/mod.rs.
close_reason: All gaps closed: AUDIT-05 (agent_unknown_app wired into emit_audit), OP-04 (encryption task shutdown signal), USB-06 (SID + owner fields through UsbEnforcer). Milestone v0.7.1 archived and tagged.

title: Reopen Phase 38.2: USB Enforcement Fix — PnP Disable Actually Works
description:
Phase 38.2 was archived as complete but USB blocking does not actually work in production. Three bugs identified:

1. INSTANCE ID MISMATCH: DeviceController::disable_usb_device constructs CM instance ID as USB\VID_{vid}&PID_{pid}\{serial} but actual CM instance IDs are location-based (e.g. USB\VID_0951&PID_1666\5&12345678&0&0), not serial-based. CM_Locate_DevNodeW fails with CR_NO_SUCH_DEVNODE and code silently returns Ok(()) — device is NOT disabled.

2. (none) SERIAL POISONING: Devices without serial descriptors get serial='(none)'. Constructed ID USB\VID_X&PID_Y\(none) never matches any real device.

3. DACL ALSO FAILS SILENTLY: set_volume_deny_all requires admin privileges; if both PnP disable AND DACL fail, no hard error is surfaced.

Fix: Use SetupDi to resolve actual CM instance ID from device interface path, then pass real instance ID to CM_Disable_DevNode. Surface hard failures when both enforcement layers fail.

title: Phase 42: Audit Enrichment — App Identity Fields (AUDIT-04)
description:
Close gaps in app identity fields across all interception paths.

## Goal
All audit events include source_application and destination_application fields where applicable. Missing identity is flagged as AGENT-UNKNOWN with remediation path.

## Requirements
- AUDIT-04: All audit events from file interception include source/destination app identity
- All audit events from USB interception include device identity fields
- All audit events from clipboard interception include both source and destination app identity
- Audit schema guarantees non-null app identity fields

## Depends On
- Phase 25 (App Identity Capture)
- Phase 39 (UWP App Identity) — COMPLETE
- Phase 40 (Drag-and-Drop Enforcement) — COMPLETE

## Success Criteria
1. File interception audit events include source_application and destination_application
2. USB audit events include VID, PID, serial, description
3. Clipboard audit events include source and destination app identity
4. Missing identity flagged as AGENT-UNKNOWN with remediation path

title: Phase 41: Browser Origin Clipboard Policies (BRW-04)
description:
Extend Chrome Enterprise Connector with origin-specific clipboard policies.

## Goal
Chrome Enterprise Connector messages include tab origin (URL/domain) for clipboard read/write operations. ABAC evaluator supports source_origin and destination_origin as condition attributes.

## Requirements
- BRW-04: Admin can author policies that allow/deny clipboard operations based on managed-origins list and specific URL patterns
- Paste from protected origin to unmanaged origin is blocked and audited with origin fields populated

## Depends On
- Phase 29 (Chrome Enterprise Connector)
- Phase 40 (Drag-and-Drop Enforcement) — COMPLETE

## Success Criteria
1. Chrome Enterprise Connector messages include tab origin for clipboard operations
2. ABAC evaluator supports source_origin and destination_origin condition attributes
3. Admin can author origin-based policies in TUI
4. Paste from protected to unmanaged origin is blocked + audited with origin fields

title: UAT 31: re-register SanDisk with full 128-char serial for ReadOnly/FullAccess enforcement test
description: The ReadOnly UAT test failed because the device was registered with a truncated 20-char serial. The full serial is 0401EFEFB391D95AEEF2935943BEE8A8624A8FE336775FCF2B19F193B0829547F75300000000000000000000942732C7FF1A631891558107BC294AC8 (128 chars from InstanceId). Delete the existing truncated entry in dlp-admin-cli Device Registry, then paste the full serial when re-registering. ReadOnly should apply set_volume_readonly; FullAccess should allow writes. Description bug (setupdi returns Intel Bluetooth name for SanDisk) is cosmetic, does not affect enforcement.

title: fix: setupdi_description_for_device returns wrong device name (Bluetooth instead of SanDisk)
description: When SanDisk USB storage (VID=0781 PID=5591) arrives, the agent logs description=Intel(R) Wireless Bluetooth(R). setupdi_description_for_device matches the wrong device in the SetupDi device list. Cosmetic only — enforcement keys on VID/PID/serial. Fix by matching device path more precisely in the SetupDi enumeration.
